findings: PRODID-R11 / FSE-210 does NOT reproduce on build c0d25917: the @-selected product id survives message → confirmation card → job. GenJob 01M2PV9ZBN5ZQXN5GRY1PQN64C has entityIds={product,actor} and approvedEntities=[{PRODUCT},{CHARACTER}], and Generation.entitySnapshot carries both with refHashes. This is the first staging receipt for the fix registered in brand-product-identity.md §5 (2026-09-16 row, PR #1420) on the Home-composer submission path.
R3-F20 is fixed in the product: /brand/records?tab=products reachable and 'Add product' present, which removes the precondition that forced the 2026-09-16 REAL-03 attempt to stop at NOT RUN.

Copy accuracy defect (new): the prompt the merchant sees on the card and in Library begins 'starting from the given first frame' and includes 'keep the subject consistent with the source frame', but this job has no first frame and no source generation (sourceGenerationId / tailGenerationId / referenceVideoGenerationId all NULL, RefGenJob=0, no intermediate IMAGE GenJob). The words claim a step the data proves did not happen — a 'trace-able' (有迹可循) mismatch in the merchant-facing receipt, not a money defect.

UX gap (new, no money impact): after a client-side Back into Home the Otto panel shows the thread title with an empty conversation body for roughly 40–60 s before the in-flight card reappears. A merchant checking on a running job in that window sees nothing.
The confirmation card quotes credits only; no provider USD estimate is exposed on any surface, so the 'provider 估价' half of REAL-20 can only come from the DB column GenJob.spentUsd after the fact.

'What the engine ran — Not reported by the engine.' on the Library detail panel is honest, not a bug: it renders Generation.finalPromptText (NULL here because the video engine returned no revised prompt), while our own send receipt Generation.sentPromptText is populated (DetailPanel.tsx:919–945).
Side evidence for PRODID-A10: creating the product and attaching its cover produced zero CreditLedger rows and left the balance untouched.
Side evidence for the 2026-09-15 auto-cover ruling (PR #1462): attaching the first reference image wrote Entity.baseAssetId back automatically (NULL → 01M2883T92MJG8DTFAXF2DJ4A1).
